# pihole_dns_upstreams (Resource)

Manages PiHole's upstream DNS servers (config.dns.upstreams). This is a singleton resource — define it at most once. Order is significant and preserved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage the ordered list of upstream DNS servers. Singleton — define at most once.
resource "pihole_dns_upstreams" "main" {
  upstreams = [
    "1.1.1.1",
    "1.0.0.1",
    "127.0.0.1#5335", # e.g. a local unbound resolver
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `upstreams` (List of String) Ordered list of upstream DNS servers (e.g. "1.1.1.1", "8.8.8.8#5353", "127.0.0.1#5335").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "upstreams".
